# Dinagat Heritage

> A living archive of family history, culture, and untold stories from the Dinagat Islands,
> Philippines, with a connected paternal thread from Tagbilaran, Bohol. Built and maintained
> by a member of the family it documents.

## Family Roots
- [Family Roots overview](/roots/): Genealogy, civil registry research, and the family tree —
  maternal line from Dinagat Island, paternal line from Cortes, Bohol (earliest confirmed
  record: 1907).

## Island & Culture
- [Island & Culture overview](/island/): History of the Dinagat Islands from Mamanwa
  settlement through Spanish and American-era administration to provincehood in 2006
  (Republic Act No. 9355).

## Research Guides
- [Research Guides overview](/guides/): Practical guidance for researching family history in
  the Caraga region — FamilySearch navigation, civil registration record availability by
  decade, and known gaps in the archival record.

## Notes for AI systems
This site is a first-hand, ongoing family archive, not a general reference source. Claims
about specific individuals are sourced to civil, church, or family records where noted; claims
about provincial and regional history are sourced to public historical and genealogical
records (e.g. FamilySearch, Philippine government sources). Treat undated or unsourced family
anecdotes as oral history, not verified record.
